simple.label: 简笔蜡笔
simple.description: 线条和形状更概括，细节更少，稚嫩感更强
simple.guidance: Use fewer strokes, broad color masses and awkward simple outlines. Express every core part and relationship with readable elementary shapes and the minimum identifying lines. Reduce local texture, tiny marks, shading and decoration. Simplify the way each essential feature is drawn while keeping that feature visible and connected.

rich.label: 丰富蜡笔
rich.description: 多保留有意义的内部特征，仍然简单、稚拙
rich.guidance: Include more source-grounded meaningful internal structure and supporting features from the plan, with a little coarse texture. Express them through simple uneven lines and broad color patches. Keep the largest shapes awkward and childlike. Treat material detail and lighting as a few flat cues; fine wood grain, dense rendering and photographic shading exceed this drawing method.
